dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Repeatable flags, conflicts, and help example are implemented; focused package tests passed.

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Case-insensitive resolution and actionable unknown-field errors are present, but ambiguous IDs retain input slice order rather than being sorted deterministically.

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: Selected-field runs reuse initial definitions and paginate only when their connection has another page; unselected runs retain the original query path.

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All specified scalar and structured value variants are rendered, joined where needed, with text normalization and empty fallback.

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: The reachable list path resolves selected fields, appends canonical headers, and performs each cell lookup by field ID, preserving empty cells.
evidence: product.diff: runList, printResults, and itemFieldValue hunks

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Lookup and pagination errors return before rendering; the focused change uses existing query, resolver, exporter, and table helpers.
evidence: product.diff: runList error returns and appendProjectFieldPages error handling

criticalGaps: Ambiguous name diagnostics do not sort candidate IDs, so their order depends on incoming field order.
